system.description: Grew up in an isolated settlement, border territory, remote colony, or community that could not depend upon immediate aid from outside.

legacy.name: Prepared Cache
legacy.text: You may reveal that you previously packed, purchased, or concealed one ordinary non-combat item appropriate to the current environment. It must be something your character could reasonably obtain through the Team's ordinary access and the character's actual circumstances and cannot be a Weapon, Armor, Guard, Implement, Consumable Kit, or other significant Combat equipment. The item becomes Temporary Equipment. The first use each Adventure is free. Each additional use creates 1 ordinary Influence pressure.

familiarity.name: Borderland Vigilance
familiarity.text: You recognize how isolated communities organize alarms, food stores, shelters, escape routes, and defensive positions. You can identify practical vulnerabilities and signs that a community expects attack, shortage, or abandonment.
